collection.title: Ford Explorer 1991 to 1996 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Explorer 1991 - 1996 model requires a 18" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper or a spoiler for the drivers side.
